# Polkadex

> Polkadex is an independent Layer 1 blockchain built with Substrate,
> engineered for high-performance decentralized trading. It combines a
> fully on-chain orderbook (limit & market orders, sub-millisecond
> matching) with non-custodial self-custody and trust-minimized
> cross-chain transfers via Hyperbridge. Originally launched within the
> Polkadot ecosystem, Polkadex now operates as a sovereign network with
> its own validator set (200+ nodes), roadmap, and governance.

Key facts:
- Token: PDEX (native, 20,000,000 total supply, 100% unlocked — no
  future emissions, no vesting overhang). PDEX is not listed on
  centralized exchanges; native PDEX is acquired on-chain via
  https://buypdex.com
- Status: Polkadex 2.0 Orderbook is live on public testnet (cross-chain
  with Ethereum Sepolia via Hyperbridge). Mainnet relaunch targeted
  Q4 2026.
- Staking: nominators earn rewards every era (~24h) by nominating
  validators; unbonding period is 28 days. Compatible wallets: Nova
  Wallet, Talisman, SubWallet, Fearless, Polkadot.js.
- The testnet is non-incentivized: no points, no airdrops, no rewards
  program — participation is to help harden the product before mainnet.

## Pages

- [Home](https://polkadex.ee/): positioning, tokenomics highlights,
  roadmap summary, staking overview, how to get PDEX
- [Testnet Guide](https://polkadex.ee/testnet-guide): step-by-step
  onboarding — wallets, faucet, cross-chain transfers, feedback channel
- [Tokenomics](https://polkadex.ee/tokeneconomics): supply, original
  distribution, unlock status
- [Roadmap](https://polkadex.ee/roadmap): full release history and
  upcoming milestones
- [Staking](https://polkadex.ee/staking): APY, validator stats, how to
  stake
- [Docs](https://docs.polkadex.ee/): technical documentation
- [Mainnet Explorer](https://explorer.polkadex.ee): live chain data,
  validators, staking rewards
